name: depot delivery round trip
comment: Positions are local ENU metres about the WORLD origin of hil_delivery_aircraft.omniworld, not about the launch point. The two delivery zones are the DELIVERY_ZONE_A and DELIVERY_ZONE_B Solids in that world; the depot is the DEPOT tower at the origin. The aircraft is hand-launched at (-60, 0, 45) heading east, so the first leg is a gentle right turn and the second is a 145 degree reversal, which is the leg that exercises the bank limit.
